    Uniform ground witness counts from nonpresilting extended terms #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_sharp_ground_witness_bound (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) :
    ∃ (G : Finset (ProjectiveClass R)), ∀ (F : Type u) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Algebra k F] [inst_2 : Fintype F] [Module.Finite k F], (∀ (p : (extendTwoTerm k F R P).source ⟶ (extendTwoTerm k F R P).target), ¬(let __src := extendTwoTerm k F R P; { source := __src.source, target := __src.target, projective_source := ⋯, projective_target := ⋯, differential := p }).IsPresilting) → ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))), Fintype.card F ≤ max 1 (Module.finrank k ↑P.target.obj * Module.finrank k ↑P.source.obj) * Module.finrank k F * s.card ∧ ∀ c ∈ s, ∃ (M : FGModuleCat R) (g : ProjectiveClass R), CategoryTheory.toSkeleton M = c ∧ g ∈ G ∧ ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsStable M ∧ Module.finrank k ↑M.obj ≤ Module.finrank k F * Module.finrank k ↑P.target.obj ∧ endolength k M ≤ Module.finrank k ↑P.target.obj

    If fixed projective terms admit no presilting differential over a finite extension, the field cardinality bounds the number of ground brick witnesses from below after division by a uniform constant and the degree. All witnesses have bounded endolength and use a fixed finite list of weights.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.exists_uniform_ground_witness_bound (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) :
    ∃ (C : ℕ) (G : Finset (ProjectiveClass R)), 0 < C ∧ ∀ (F : Type u) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Algebra k F] [inst_2 : Fintype F] [Module.Finite k F], (∀ (p : (extendTwoTerm k F R P).source ⟶ (extendTwoTerm k F R P).target), ¬(let __src := extendTwoTerm k F R P; { source := __src.source, target := __src.target, projective_source := ⋯, projective_target := ⋯, differential := p }).IsPresilting) → ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))), Fintype.card F ≤ C * Module.finrank k F * s.card ∧ ∀ c ∈ s, ∃ (M : FGModuleCat R) (g : ProjectiveClass R), CategoryTheory.toSkeleton M = c ∧ g ∈ G ∧ ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsStable M ∧ Module.finrank k ↑M.obj ≤ Module.finrank k F * Module.finrank k ↑P.target.obj ∧ endolength k M ≤ Module.finrank k ↑P.target.obj

    The uniform bound with an existential constant used in the asymptotic growth estimates.
